label: 182-spring
notes: CONFOUND (#200): A and D had Spring's AGENTS.md (4,262 characters, 1,804 tokens by first-call usage) in their context; in C the CLAUDE.md of myc setup-claude shadows it, so the line 'Same in every condition' above does not hold for instruction files. With it added to each of C's model calls and behaviour held fixed, C / A would be 1.16x in tokens (measured 1.02x) and 0.90x-1.08x in cost (measured 0.89x): point estimates, POSTHOC.md.

TWO CLI VERSIONS: 46 sessions from 21:46 UTC (A 15, C 15, D 16, all repetition 3) ran Claude Code 2.1.331, 224 ran 2.1.330. Without repetition 3: C / A 0.97x tokens and 0.86x cost, D / A 2.56x and 2.16x (POSTHOC.md, with intervals).

Pre-registered in commit 7b2b2d1 (pushed before the first session); calibration sessions are not pooled. Primary outcome: tokens and cost per solved task. Success and F1 are a harm check: arm A was at the ceiling, so the run cannot show a success gain, and a true loss below about 25-29 points would likely be missed. No significant difference is not evidence of equal success.

Reading: no difference between C (myc + grep) and A was detected in pooled tokens or cost per solved task; the comparison is confounded as above. Post hoc: C used myc in 13 of 18 deep-transitive sessions and in 0 of 72 others, with the server, routing block, SessionStart line and grep hints present. D (myc only) cost about 2.3x and used about 2.7x the tokens of A per solved task; calls made only for refused commands are 13.4 % of its input (2.33x without them, point estimate). D is not a fair proxy for docs and by-name tasks. By category (6 tasks each) D used more tokens than A everywhere except deep transitive (0.73x, interval includes 1). Turns above are tool calls + 1; model calls per session are A 3.8, C 3.5, D 6.3. README, Result of the main run (#182).

Limits: gold agent-labelled, not human-checked; Spring is very likely in the training data (five sessions, C 3 and D 2, answered one concept task exactly without any tool call; SUPPLEMENT.md counts unseen items); 12 comparisons, only McNemar corrected; cost per session and cache writes fell over the run and 31 sessions (A 12, C 16, D 3) have no cache write, so cost ratios need care; known myc gaps #186, #187, #188, #194.

Index: 145,670 of 145,670 symbols embedded in 17,699 s (other jobs running; 98,952 s user CPU, 6.9 GB peak memory, 1.2 GB on disk); fingerprint sha256 fc3c476d228fc2d39c87cb840f73187297919761a03acf742b3dff80033e3a0f (sorted relative path + file sha256, 3,902 files).

Run 2026-11-23 20:27-22:01 UTC, one session at a time, no retries. Wall times are comparable between the arms only because the schedule interleaves them (load 12-91, median 31, from other jobs). Outside/network audit of all 270 transcripts: outside_audit.json; no session read a gold file or a later Spring version.
